report.root_cause: Player xX_Creeper_Xx joined at 08:16:27 and systematically broke a build's wall at world x=8, y=-60..-57, z=8..14 (27 blocks: oak_planks and 3 glass_pane at y=-58 z=10-12), about 1 block/s, next to where Alex_Builds logged in. BlockLog plugins/BlockLog/blocks.csv recorded every break. Mira_Crafts was only placing cobblestone at her own site (-22..-17,-60,20..21), which is normal.
report.actions: 1) Watched status and logs; baseline was healthy. 2) Read plugins/BlockLog/blocks.csv and found xX_Creeper_Xx breaking blocks in sequence at x=8. 3) Declared the incident. 4) Ran /ban xX_Creeper_Xx, which disconnected them; the breaks stopped at 14:17:00. 5) Restored exactly the 27 logged blocks to their logged previous state with /fill ... replace minecraft:air (oak_planks at y=-60,-59 z8-14; y=-58 z8-9,13-14; y=-57 z8-13; glass_pane at y=-58 z10-12). 6) Checked with execute if block (passed) and banlist, then watched for about 60 s: no more breaks, TPS 20, other players unaffected. No restart, no file changes.
report.residual_risk: The server runs in offline mode, so the griefer could come back under another username; an IP ban was not applied. Any items xX_Creeper_Xx collected from the broken blocks are still in their inventory. I could not parse protected.json to confirm who owns the build; the wall's location at Alex_Builds' spawn and the way it was dismantled point to griefing.
